meaning: reports/release.json production_status and release_ready only say the route passed Synth's router and DRC gates. They are not review sign-off.

routing_and_drc.evidence: DRC: 197 unconnected pads. 3 open nets (+3V3, USB_DP, VIN_5V_FUSED). Routing failed due to placement issues (connectors not flush, support parts too far from pads). Placement requires revision.

erc_dispositioned.evidence: 66 ERC warnings, 0 errors. See synth_validate output.

placement_review.evidence: Visual review requires revision: J1/J2/J3 not flush with board edges, 14+ support parts too far from served pads, decoupling caps too far from MCU.
